messages:
Priya: Quick thread: where to put Export in trace detail and how to make correlation-id copy accessible. Small mocks linked: https://img.redwood.local/mock/trace-mini.png

Noah: Inline copy button next to correlation id is best. Make it a real button with aria-label "Copy correlation ID" and announce via aria-live: "Correlation ID copied to clipboard". Tooltip ok but not required for SR.

Connor: Agree. Also ensure Tab order: row content -> copy -> expand -> kebab. Currently kebab appears before copy which is confusing for keyboard users.

Evelyn: For Export: quick JSON export as an icon button in header (left of kebab) plus full options in kebab (HAR, CSV). Quick export should be a button with aria-label "Quick export trace (JSON)" and keyboard shortcut Shift+E in tooltip.

Priya: Good. Accessibility nits: announce filename when starting download: "Downloading Trace-<id>.json" and avoid focus traps when stack frames modal opens.

Noah: Frame folding: collapse vendor frames by default with a toggle labeled "3 library frames collapsed (expand)". Toggle should move focus into first revealed frame on expand.

Connor: I'll run contrast checks on icon hover states and ensure hover meets 4.5:1. Also add role=status element for progressive export feedback.

QA-Bot: Add e2e: copy correlation id asserts aria-live text and export asserts download filename.

DeployBot: Staging deploy scheduled 2026-04-05T04:00:00Z for these UX changes.

Priya: Thanks; I'll post updated mocks (icon-only vs icon+label) and acceptance criteria later.
